# What check-state.py still finds on main, and what removes each line. See CLAUDE.md, State, and ADR 0114.
#
# Every pull request that fixes a finding deletes its lines. Lines may only leave: a new one, or a higher limit, fails
# CI. Only a line tagged "# may become a marker" may leave by becoming a marker in the script's MARKED, with its reason;
# a new tag fails too. The last pull request of the work deletes this file and sets ENGINE_LIFECYCLE_LIMIT in the
# script.
#
engine-lifecycle-fields 31

# Slot occupant: split. busy, job and job_started become one value owned by Occupant, in its own leaf file.
C1 core Occupant

# Watch: split. A capture and its recapture become one value per runner.
C2 captures recaptures

# Job followed: split. queued_jobs, closing and claims become one map of a job's phase.
C1 core Claims
C2 closing queued_jobs

# Repository presence: split. draining folds into repositories, so these false pairs go with it.
C1 core Drain
C2 draining repositories
C2 draining retired
C2 draining slots

# Repository state: split. Its listing, holds and waits each become one sealed value, the waits last.
C1 core RepositoryState

# Measured: split raised out (slot occupant), which seals what stays, the predictor and the log memos, with private
# fields.
C1 core crates/core/src/scheduler/engine/admission.rs:Measured
